newsitem.title: UK: Europe funds upbeat on equities, bond bears gather.
newsitem.headline: Europe funds upbeat on equities, bond bears gather.

text.p: Continental European fund managers are bullish about equities but bearish on the outlook for bonds in the region, a survey by Merrill Lynch said.

It said all fund managers in the region in its May survey expected an improvement in the economic situation over the next 12 months, while on a one-year view, bulls outnumbered bears on equities by a balance of 52 percent.
It said bond market bears were in the majority by a balance of 68 percent.
It also said continental European fund managers were bullish on the outlook for Japanese equities.
The survey also found that 94 percent of respondents expected some form of EU monetary union including Germany and France to go ahead on time.
The survey was carried out by Gallup on behalf of Merrill between May 1 and 7, covering 63 institutions responsible for funds totalling $623 billion.
